entities.name: Aldon
entities.description: A human figure from a Dominarian fable who struggled to reclaim his castle from the wizard Dreygar.

entities.name: Dreygar
entities.description: A wizard who took Aldon's castle and was killed by him.

entities.name: Serra Angel
entities.description: An angel summoned by Aldon who fell in love with him and later died fighting the fallen angel.

entities.name: Fallen angel
entities.description: An angel sent by Dreygar to seduce and corrupt Aldon, who betrayed him and killed the Serra Angel.

entities.name: Dark Amulet
entities.description: An amulet of black mana that Aldon retrieved from one of Dreygar's summons.

entities.name: Aldon's Hovel
entities.description: A cottage in the swamps where Aldon took refuge, later transformed into a place of greenery.

entities.name: Aldon's castle
entities.description: The castle Aldon lost to Dreygar and later reclaimed.

events.summary: Dreygar takes Aldon's castle in the western Domains and Aldon goes into exile in the swamplands.
events.quote: Aldon was a young man who lost his castle to the wizard Dreygar

events.summary: Aldon retrieves a Dark Amulet from one of Dreygar's summons.
events.quote: One of Dreygar's summons held a Dark Amulet that Aldon retrieved.

events.summary: Using the amulet's black mana, Aldon summons a vampire, a frozen shade and a bog wraith as allies.
events.quote: His first allies were a vampire

events.summary: Aldon summons a Serra Angel, who shows him the beauty of the world; they fall in love.
events.quote: They grew close and fell in love.

events.summary: Dreygar sends a fallen angel who seduces and corrupts Aldon.
events.quote: Dreygar, determined to keep his hold on the castle, responded by sending a fallen angel to seduce and corrupt Aldon.

events.summary: Aldon assaults the castle; the fallen angel betrays him, the two angels slay each other, and Aldon kills Dreygar.
events.quote: The two angels slew each other, and Aldon killed Dreygar in a rage.

events.summary: Aldon reclaims and rules his castle, forever mourning his lost love.
events.quote: Aldon reclaimed his castle and ruled it once again

relations.note: Killed in a rage during the assault.
relations.quote: Aldon killed Dreygar in a rage
They grew close and fell in love.

relations.note: The two angels slew each other.
relations.quote: The two angels slew each other

relations.note: Her true loyalty was to Dreygar.
relations.quote: showing her true loyalty to Dreygar
